title: Checkout — Graceful Handling
description: Create a /checkout route that shows a 'coming soon' page with bag contents, and update the Buy Now button to navigate there instead of silently failing.
acceptanceCriteria: /checkout route exists and renders a 'coming soon' page
Checkout page displays current bag contents (items, quantities, total)
Checkout page has a clear 'coming soon' message
Buy Now button on product page navigates to /checkout
Page uses existing design patterns (Section, Container, Typography)
Has proper Next.js metadata (title: 'Checkout — SUS WEARS')
verification: Dev server renders /checkout with bag contents
context: The current checkout at src/lib/checkout.ts returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'not-available', message: 'Checkout opens in a later phase' }`. The ProductPage at src/components/product/ProductPage.tsx calls startCheckout() on 'Buy Now' click (around line 120). Instead of silently failing, the Buy Now button should navigate to /checkout. The checkout page should read the bag from localStorage using readBag() from src/lib/bag.ts and display the items with a 'coming soon' message. Follow the CartPage pattern for displaying bag contents.
